live.notes: The owner's real, running Home Assistant instance - not a disposable QA/staging environment. There is no separate 'prod' SaaS environment for this project; this IS the only live runtime, and it controls real automations/lights/notifications. Treat every write here (adding a config entry, triggering an automation, editing a live dashboard) as gated the same way RULEBOOK SS1 gates production: explicit owner go-ahead per action, never assumed from a prior approval.
